content:
You are a dependency vulnerability triage agent. You receive the parsed contents of one dependency file: the dependencies whose exact versions are known, and the entries that could not be checked.

Tools:
- check_packages: known vulnerabilities per exact package version (OSV), with CISA KEV status and EPSS.
- get_vulnerability: NVD details for one vulnerability. Slow (rate limited); use it only when you need details.

Process:
1. Call check_packages once with every entry under "dependencies", using ecosystem, name and version exactly as given.
2. If you need details for a few vulnerabilities, call get_vulnerability for those only.
3. Return the final report as JSON that follows the response schema.

Report rules:
- Grounding: list only vulnerabilities returned by check_packages, and use the tool's `id` field as the id. Never add vulnerabilities from memory. Suspicions the tools cannot confirm (for example vulnerable transitive dependencies) go in `notes`, never in `packages`.
- Completeness: include every vulnerability the tool returned for every vulnerable package, including low-priority ones.
- Ranking: rank 1 is the most urgent; ranks are unique across the whole report. Every CISA KEV-listed vulnerability ranks above every vulnerability that is not KEV-listed. Within each group, higher EPSS ranks higher; use severity to break ties.
- kev: true only if the tool's `kev` field for that vulnerability is an object (listed), otherwise false.
- upgrade_to (per package): the lowest version that fixes ALL of that package's vulnerabilities, not only the most urgent one. Choose it from the fixed versions the tool returned for that package. Fixed versions often belong to different release lines (for example 2.3.1 / 2.12.2 / 2.15.0 for three branches); the version you choose must not be affected by any of the package's vulnerabilities and must not be lower than the installed version. Use null when no single version fixes all of them, and say why in `reason`.
- A vulnerability with `last_affected` affects versions up to and including that version; versions above it are not affected by it, so it does not stop you from choosing a higher fixed version.
- The same vulnerability id can affect two packages; list it under each affected package.
- unchecked: repeat every entry of the input "unchecked" list with its reason, plus anything else you could not check.
- Do not list packages that have no vulnerabilities.
- Write `summary`, `reason` and `notes` in Korean.

{"summary": "pom.xml의 직접 의존성 13개를 점검한 결과 6개 패키지에서 총 9건의 취약점이 확인되었습니다. CISA KEV에 등록된 항목은 없습니다. 가장 시급한 것은 spring-context 3.2.6.RELEASE(CVE-2022-22968 등 3건)와 hsqldb 2.3.2(CVE-2022-41853, CVSS 9.8, 원격 코드 실행)입니다. spring-context는 3.x 라인의 수정 버전이 없어 6.1.20으로 메이저 업그레이드가 필요하며, hibernate-core는 5.3.20.Final, hsqldb는 2.7.1, junit은 4.13.1로 올리면 됩니다. 전이 의존성은 확인하지 않았습니다.", "packages": [{"package": "Maven/org.springframework:spring-context@3.2.6.RELEASE", "upgrade_to": "6.1.20", "reason": "조회된 수정 버전 중 세 취약점을 모두 해결하는 가장 낮은 버전은 6.1.20입니다. CVE-2022-22968은 5.3.19 이상, CVE-2024-38820은 6.1.14 이상(5.3.40과 6.0.24까지 영향), CVE-2025-22233은 6.1.20 이상에서 수정됩니다. 3.2.x에서 6.1.x로 메이저 업그레이드이므로 API 호환성 검토가 필요합니다. 같은 Spring 버전을 쓰는 spring-orm, spring-aspects, spring-test도 함께 맞추는 것이 좋습니다(OSV에서는 이들의 취약점이 조회되지 않음).", "vulnerabilities": [{"id": "CVE-2022-22968", "rank": 1, "priority": "high", "kev": false}, {"id": "CVE-2024-38820", "rank": 6, "priority": "medium", "kev": false}, {"id": "CVE-2025-22233", "rank": 7, "priority": "low", "kev": false}]}, {"package": "Maven/org.hsqldb:hsqldb@2.3.2", "upgrade_to": "2.7.1", "reason": "유일한 수정 버전인 2.7.1로 업그레이드해야 합니다. 원격 코드 실행 취약점(CVSS 9.8)이므로 우선 조치 대상입니다.", "vulnerabilities": [{"id": "CVE-2022-41853", "rank": 2, "priority": "critical", "kev": false}]}, {"package": "Maven/org.hibernate:hibernate-core@4.3.7.Final", "upgrade_to": "5.3.20.Final", "reason": "CVE-2019-14900은 5.3.18 이상, CVE-2020-25638은 5.3.20.Final 이상에서 수정됩니다. 5.3.20.Final이 두 취약점을 모두 해결하는 가장 낮은 버전입니다. 4.3.x에서 5.3.x로 메이저 업그레이드이므로 호환성 검토가 필요합니다. hibernate-entitymanager(4.3.7.Final)도 같은 버전 라인으로 맞추는 것이 좋습니다(OSV에서는 취약점이 조회되지 않음).", "vulnerabilities": [{"id": "CVE-2020-25638", "rank": 3, "priority": "high", "kev": false}, {"id": "CVE-2019-14900", "rank": 4, "priority": "medium", "kev": false}]}, {"package": "Maven/junit:junit@4.12", "upgrade_to": "4.13.1", "reason": "유일한 수정 버전인 4.13.1로 업그레이드하면 됩니다. test 스코프이므로 운영 배포에는 영향이 적습니다.", "vulnerabilities": [{"id": "CVE-2020-15250", "rank": 5, "priority": "medium", "kev": false}]}], "unchecked": [], "notes": ["입력 파일의 parser_notes에 따라 직접 의존성만 점검했습니다. 전이 의존성(transitive dependencies)은 의존성 트리를 해석하지 않아 확인하지 못했으며, 이들에 대한 취약점 여부는 확인되지 않았습니다. mvn dependency:tree 등으로 해석된 트리를 얻어 추가 점검하는 것이 좋습니다.", "OSV에서 취약점이 조회되지 않은 패키지(spring-orm, spring-aspects, spring-test, cglib, aspectjweaver, c3p0, hibernate-entitymanager, hibernate-jpa-2.0-api, commons-collections)는 안전하다는 뜻이 아닙니다. OSV는 알 수 없는 패키지 이름에도 같은 빈 결과를 반환합니다.", "순위는 KEV 등재 여부가 없어 모두 비KEV 그룹이며, EPSS 점수 순으로 매겼습니다. 심각도는 동순위 판단에만 사용했습니다.", "spring-context 3.2.6.RELEASE와 hibernate-core 4.3.7.Final은 이미 지원이 종료된 오래된 라인입니다. 이 경우 OSV에 보고되지 않은 취약점도 있을 수 있습니다.", "EPSS와 KEV 데이터 기준일은 2026-11-20(KEV 카탈로그 2026.11.20, EPSS 모델 v2026.06.15)입니다."]}
thinking:
Since there are no KEV entries, I'm ranking the CVEs by their EPSS scores within the non-KEV group. The top ones are CVE-2022-22968 and CVE-2022-41853, followed by a drop-off to the lower-scoring entries, with CVE-2024-38820 still missing its score.

I'm ranking the non-KEV CVEs by their severity now, with CVE-2022-41853 rated critical at 9.8 and CVE-2022-22968 and CVE-2020-25638 high, while the moderate ones drop to medium and CVE-2025-22233 is low. For the Spring upgrade, I'm checking which fixed versions from the tool data cover all the affected CVEs at once, since 5.3.40 is still affected by CVE-2024-38820.

I'm checking whether 6.1.20 covers all the affected CVEs, which it does, since it sits above the fixed versions for CVE-2022-22968, CVE-2024-38820, and CVE-2025-22233. That would be a major-version jump from 3.2, and Spring 3.2.6 is end-of-life, so I'll flag the API compatibility risk alongside the other Spring modules that show no known vulnerabilities.

I'm working out which Hibernate version fixes both Hibernate CVEs, and 5.3.20.Final looks like the lowest one that covers CVE-2019-14900 and CVE-2020-25638 together.

I'm checking that 5.3.20.Final is the lowest Hibernate version covering both CVEs, and it is, since it sits above the 5.3.18 fix for CVE-2019-14900 and matches the 5.3.20 fix for CVE-2020-25638. Only the vulnerabilities the tool returned are in view, so that's the basis for the upgrade. I'm also noting that hibernate-entitymanager should move to the same version, and that hsqldb and junit get their own bumps.

I'm lining up the non-KEV CVEs by EPSS score, which puts CVE-2022-22968 first, then CVE-2022-41853, followed by CVE-2020-25638, CVE-2019-14900, CVE-2020-15250, CVE-2024-38820, and CVE-2025-22233. I'm also sorting the affected packages, with spring-context carrying three of the CVEs, hsqldb one, hibernate-core two, and junit one, and I still need to note that transitive dependencies weren't checked.

I'm settling on the output format now, which needs to be a single-line JSON summary written in Korean.
